requirements.quote: A scheduler enqueues per-member jobs at the member's configured local time (default 20:00 and 07:00 Asia/Kolkata) and the evening job fires only when the member has at least one listing tomorrow. [type:unit]
Each reminder is idempotent through `reminder_dispatch(member_id, kind, date)` unique key; a retried job sends nothing twice. [type:unit]

Evening brief content: count of listings, halls, clashes, briefs below readiness 60, and obligations due tomorrow, with a deep link to `/tomorrow`; no party names appear in push payloads (they appear only in-app). [type:unit]
Morning job sends only when the list diff for today is non-empty and summarises added, moved and removed items with a deep link to the diff sheet. [type:unit]

Outcome-missing reminder fires once per hearing at the configured delay (default 90 minutes after the last item in that hall or 16:30) for appearances with no confirmed outcome, to the appearing member and, for delegated appearances, the owner. [type:unit]
Members can disable each kind and each channel (in-app, push, email) in preferences; opt-outs are respected and tested. [type:api]

Quiet-period guard: no reminders are sent on court holidays with no listings and none are scheduled inside the change-freeze windows by deploy tooling; clock handling is tested across IST with a fake clock. [type:unit]
Email goes through the console transport in dev and CI and SES when configured; push uses VAPID web push through the service worker. [type:unit]
All recipients are workspace members; a static test asserts there is no code path that addresses a client or external email. [type:unit]
Failures are retried with backoff then dead-lettered through the job registry (#15 conventions) and surface in the admin health feed. [type:unit]
Settings card renders in all states (loading, error, saved, denied) and is accessible; the whole control is keyboard operable. [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: Playwright e2e/a11y run in CI on ship PRs and nightly (never locally); in lane the card is covered by a jsdom component test of all four states and keyboard operation.

requirements.quote: Cross-tenant tests pass: a user in workspace A cannot read or mutate this feature's rows in workspace B via SQL, service, server action or API, including a user who belongs to both. [type:api]
Every new tenant table has `workspace_id uuid not null`, an RLS policy using `app.workspace_id`, and is covered by the CI cross-tenant suite. [type:unit]
Inputs are validated with zod schemas from `packages/validators`; no `any` appears in exported types. [type:unit]
Local scheduled notifications are the primary path for mobile where the PWA supports it, with server push as backup (PRD recovery table).
requirements.why: Needs a service-worker/PWA local-notification scheduler that is client work with its own device testing; this change delivers the server push backup path. Follow-up issue.

requirements.quote: none are scheduled inside the change-freeze windows by deploy tooling
requirements.why: Deploy tooling lives outside this repo's app code; this change keeps the evening slot inside 18:00-23:00 and the morning job at 07:00 (the existing freeze-safe window used by the #49 digest) and records the constraint in the ADR. Tooling enforcement is separate.

decisions.choice: Define the reminder jobs in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/reminders.ts, not apps/worker/src/jobs/ as the issue lists.
decisions.justification: apps/worker has no jobs dir; every job is a core definition registered in packages/core/src/jobs/registry.ts (activity-digest.ts, registry.ts:~171) and the worker runs the registry (apps/worker/src/worker.ts, schedules.ts:10).

decisions.choice: Keep a dedicated reminder_dispatch table for idempotency even though once() exists.
decisions.justification: The issue's acceptance criteria require the (member_id, kind, for_date[, channel]) unique key, and per-channel dispatch rows allow a retry after a partial failure to resend only the failed channel; once() (packages/core/src/jobs/idempotency.ts) is per job effect.

decisions.choice: Store prefs through new notification categories plus notification_setting-style time fields, with workspace defaults, instead of M2 memory_item keys.
decisions.justification: #72 (memory engine) is open and the issue says to fall back to defaults when it is absent; the digest preference (packages/notifications/src/service.ts:620-632) is the working precedent.

decisions.choice: Email templates and i18n files go under packages/notifications/src/email/templates and packages/i18n/src/messages, not the issue's paths.
decisions.justification: Actual layout in the repo (email/templates/end-of-day-digest.tsx, i18n catalog.ts:7).

decisions.choice: Scheduler lists cross-workspace targets via an owner-defined SQL function in the migration, as app_notification_digest_targets() does.
decisions.justification: Tenant tables are FORCE RLS and the scheduler job has no workspace (activity-digest.ts header and runActivityDigestSchedule).
